title: Isolation of Human Bone Marrow Non-hematopoietic Cells for Single-cell RNA Sequencing
author: Hongzhe Li

steps.title: Prepare Ficoll gradient tubes
steps.instruction: Label five 50 mL Falcon tubes and add 15 mL of Ficoll‑Paque Premium to each.

steps.title: Dilute bone marrow in Ficoll
steps.instruction: Transfer the 50–60 mL bone‑marrow aspirate into a sterile T‑75 culture flask, add 100 mL Ficoll buffer (PBS + 0.6 % ACDA + 2 % FBS) and mix by pipetting up and down.

steps.title: Layer suspension onto Ficoll
steps.instruction: Carefully layer 30 mL of the bone‑marrow/Ficoll mixture over the 15 mL Ficoll‑Paque in each of the five prepared Falcon tubes.

steps.title: Density gradient centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tubes at 300 × g for 30 min at room temperature without brakes (acceleration = 6, deceleration = 0) using a swinging‑bucket rotor.

steps.title: Harvest mononuclear cell layer
steps.instruction: Collect the interphase containing mononuclear cells from each tube into five new 50 mL Falcon tubes and bring each tube to 50 mL with additional Ficoll buffer.

steps.title: Wash cells by centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the five tubes for 15 min at 400 × g at 4 °C.

steps.title: Prepare 1× Pharm Lyse
steps.instruction: Mix 3.5 mL BD Pharm Lyse™ Lysing Buffer with 31.5 mL sterile distilled water to obtain 35 mL of 1× Pharm Lyse solution.

steps.title: Lyse cells with Pharm Lyse
steps.instruction: After the 400 × g spin, aspirate supernatant and add 7 mL of 1× Pharm Lyse to each tube; gently pipette up and down to resuspend the pellets.

steps.title: Incubate lysed cells
steps.instruction: Combine the five lysed suspensions into one 50 mL Falcon tube, vortex gently, and incubate for 15 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Pellet and block cells
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 200 × g for 15 min at 4 °C, aspirate supernatant, and resuspend the pellet in 250 µL Blocking buffer (PBS + 1:50 Gammanorm + 1 % FBS, sterile‑filtered).

steps.title: Dilute cells for counting
steps.instruction: Take 5 µL of the blocked cell suspension and add 995 µL Blocking buffer to obtain a 2 : 100 dilution for cell counting.

steps.title: Count cells and adjust concentration
steps.instruction: Count cells with a NucleoCounter NC‑250, multiply the count by the dilution factor (200) to obtain the original number, and dilute or concentrate the suspension to a final concentration of 2 × 10⁸ – 2 × 10⁹ cells/mL using Blocking buffer.

steps.title: Block cells before staining
steps.instruction: Incubate the cell suspension in Blocking buffer for 20 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Aliquot cells and antibodies
steps.instruction: Aliquot cells and the appropriate antibodies into staining tubes according to Table 1 (CD45 low/‑ CD235a‑ panel) or Table 2 (CD45 low/‑ CD235a‑ CD271⁺ panel).

steps.title: Incubate antibody staining
steps.instruction: Incubate the staining tubes for 30 min at 4 °C in the dark.

steps.title: Wash stained cells
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL Sorting buffer to each tube, centrifuge 5 min at 800 × g at 4 °C, and discard supernatant.

steps.title: Add DAPI and filter
steps.instruction: Resuspend tubes a–e (or a’–g’) with 500 µL Sorting buffer and add 2.5 µL sterile DAPI stock; resuspend tube f (or h’) with 3 mL Sorting buffer and add 15 µL DAPI stock. Pass the cell suspensions through a 30 µm Filcon (or equivalent) filter.

steps.title: Set up FACS instrument
steps.instruction: Open BD FACSDiva, create an FSC‑A vs SSC‑A plot, adjust FSC and SSC PMT settings, and configure the following gates: (1) polygon gate to exclude FSC‑low debris, (2) FSC‑H vs FSC‑A to exclude doublets, (3) FSC‑A vs DAPI to exclude dead cells, (4) FITC vs PE‑Cy5 to exclude CD45‑high and CD235a‑positive cells, (5) FSC‑A vs APC to exclude CD271‑negative cells.

substeps.instruction: Create FSC‑A vs SSC‑A plot and set PMT gains.
Draw polygon gate around FSC‑medium/high population.
Create FSC‑H vs FSC‑A plot and gate out doublets.
Create FSC‑A vs DAPI plot and gate out DAPI‑high (non‑viable) cells.
Create FITC vs PE‑Cy5 plot and gate out CD45‑high/CD235a‑positive cells.
Create FSC‑A vs APC plot and gate out CD271‑negative cells.

steps.title: Sort target cell populations
steps.instruction: Sort 100 events from the desired CD45 low/‑ CD235a‑ or CD45 low/‑ CD235a‑ CD271⁺ gate into a tube containing 100 µL ice‑cold Collection buffer, re‑analyse to confirm >85 % purity, then collect the bulk target fraction into a tube with 700 µL ice‑cold Collection buffer.

steps.title: Post‑sort handling and scRNA‑seq prep
steps.instruction: Count the sorted cells, resuspend exactly 20 000 cells in 47 µL ice‑cold Collection buffer, and immediately proceed to single‑cell RNA sequencing using the 10× Genomics Chromium Controller and Chromium Single Cell Gene Expression 3’ v3 kit.

description: Validation of protocol This protocol or parts of it has been used and validated in the following research article: Li et al. [3]. Identification of phenotypically, functionally, and anatomically distinct stromal niche populations in human bone marrow based on single-cell RNA sequencing. eLife ( Figure 1 , panel A).
